thread:
Maya: Heads-up — NovaHealth wants a POC that needs Private/VPC isolation + customer-managed KMS for audit logs. They also require Splunk HEC ingestion and 90d retention. Can we provision a short-lived Private POC and provide the audit artifacts they asked for (schema, sample sanitized logs, IAM trust, network diagram)?

Tony: cc @Kevin — quick Q: can we satisfy this with a Hosted API key scoped to something, or do they need a Private deployment/Dedicated pool in their VPC? They explicitly want no egress to public internet for data plane.

Kevin: Hosted API keys cannot be VPC-restricted today. For no-egress + BYOK KMS we need either Private (customer VPC peering / Private deployment) or a Dedicated pool placed in their VPC. For a POC we can spin a Private trial environment, but it requires infra ticket + networking approvals.

Anita: Security checklist items we need up front: audit log retention policy, who controls the CMK (BYOK ARN), key rotation plan, encryption-in-transit (HEC TLS + mTLS preferred), and a list of sensitive fields we should redact before logging (PII, PHI, full prompt text?). Also we need the completed security questionnaire before we enable BYOK.

Maya: They prefer Splunk HEC over S3. They'll give us a collector endpoint and a long-lived HEC token if acceptable. They also asked that API keys issuance/rotation and admin actions show up in logs.

Kevin: Implementation notes: we can forward logs from the private env to Splunk HEC over an outbound NAT with TLS. If they want CMK encryption of payloads at rest before shipping, they must grant our log-shipper account access to the CMK (cross-account key policy + Grant). We'll need the CMK ARN and an IAM role to assume.

Maya: Also commercial question from the buyer: 30-day POC with Dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv). Do we have a standard POC rate or discount? They need pricing attached to the SOW before starting.

Tony: We normally offer a POC discount — propose 40% off the monthly reserved rate for a 30d trial. I'll draft a price line item but need RevOps approval. If they accept Hosted credits instead (less isolation), we can credit XX dollars.

Anita: For compliance evidence during POC we'll require: 1) sanitized sample logs and schema, 2) KMS cross-account policy doc (or statement if they decline BYOK), 3) network diagram showing peering + NAT + security groups, 4) mapping to SOC2 control families for access/audit logging. If they refuse BYOK, we can use our KMS but legal will require an addendum.

Kevin: Regarding credentials: we can issue a scoped API key limited to a particular model and token cap, and tag it to the customer tenant. That issuance will be recorded in our audit logs. For Splunk HEC token rotation we can rotate on our side or ask them to rotate and provide new token; recommend short-lived (30d) rotation for POC.

Maya: Customer also asked about the ability to export full logs to their SIEM after POC ends. Confirmed they want continuous export and an S3 backup with KMS encryption.

Kevin: Action items from infra: create Private POC env, configure log forwarder, create IAM role/trust policy for BYOK, enable audit logging for API key issuance, and set retention to 90d. I'll need the CMK ARN and Splunk HEC URL/token.

Kevin: Draft trust policy + example HEC test curl (posting sanitized sample):
```
# Example IAM trust policy (customer CMK cross-account grant)
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDSHIFT_LOGSHIPPER_ACCOUNT:role/log-shipper" },
      "Action": [ "kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey*" ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE-CMK-ARN"
    }
  ]
}

# Test HEC call (sanitized)
curl -k -H 'Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://splunk.example.com:8088/services/collector -d '{"event":"test-log","env":"poc-sandbox"}'
```

Anita: Sounds good. I'll start the questionnaire and enumerate required artifacts — aiming for a 3 business day turnaround for our side to review. Legal will need to sign the BYOK clause; flagging for contracts.

Maya: I opened ticket INC-4123 with deploy-bot for provisioning. ETA 72 hours unless networking requires manual peering. @Tony can you draft the SOW with the POC price and the BYOK clause so we can get countersigned?

Tony: Will do. Drafted a short SOW template and will attach a POC discount line. Looping @Anita for compliance language and @Kevin for infra items.

Kevin: I'll post the networking checklist in the ticket and request a collector IP allowlist. If we hit a blocker (e.g., they want no NAT), we may need to run an on-prem agent or dedicate a peering-only path.

Maya: Thanks team. I'll collect Splunk endpoint + CMK ARN from the customer and upload sanitized sample logs. Will update INC-4123 when I have them. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Ticket INC-4123 created and assigned to infra-poc. Priority: high. ETA: 72h.

audit-bot: Reminder: attach sample log schema and redaction checklist to the ticket before enabling live shipping.

Tony: If anyone's blocked on approvals, ping me; I can escalate to RevOps/Legal.

Anita: One more note — redact full user prompts by default unless customer signs off to persist them. Marking as REQUIRED for data minimization during POC.

Maya: Noted — I will confirm with the customer and prefer sanitized prompts only.

Kevin: OK proceeding with prep. I'll post the final config snippet in INC-4123 when ready.

Maya: Great — closing loop for now. Will update when customer provides CMK ARN + Splunk details. :white_check_mark:
